item.title: United States wins Olympic gold medal in women's hockey, defeating Canada 2-1
item.description: United States wins its third Olympic gold medal in women's hockey, beating Canada 2-1 on Megan Keller's goal in overtime.

item.title: Alysa Liu wins first women's figure skating gold medal for the US in 24 years
item.description: Alysa Liu delivered the U.S. its first women’s figure skating Olympic gold medal in 24 years, performing a near-flawless free skate on Thursday night in a glittering golden dress to upstage Japanese rivals Kaori Sakamoto and Ami Nakai at the Milan Cortina Games.

item.title: 'Grey's Anatomy' star Eric Dane dies after ALS battle
item.description: Actor Eric Dane, best known for his role as Dr. Mark Sloan ("McSteamy") on ABC's "Grey's Anatomy" has died at the age of 53.

item.title: Rampart basketball rolls by 76-61 over Pueblo West
item.description: (COLORADO SPRINGS) — Rampart boys basketball (18-5) erupted in the first quarter and never looked back in its regular season finale, 76-61, home victory over Pueblo West (15-7) on Thursday night. Pueblo West, meanwhile, will close out its regular season hosting Liberty at 1 p.m. on Saturday afternoon.
